sourceTiers.text: In the moon's phases lie the secrets of waxing and waning. When any direct damage you deal triggers Affinity, you gain #YMoonphase#E for #Y5#E seconds, increasing damage dealt by #Y1%#E. Stacks up to #Y5#E times.

In the moon's phases lie the secrets of waxing and waning. When any direct damage you deal triggers Affinity, you gain #YMoonphase#E for #Y5#E seconds, increasing damage dealt by #Y1%#E. Stacks up to #Y5#E times.
Where the moon meets the sea, the rocks stand sharp as carved stone. While maxed out, all #YMoonphase#E stacks are condensed into #YMoonlure#E, consuming #Y5%#E of your current HP, while increasing damage dealt by #Y5%#E and <Direct Affinity Rate|780|#C|150> by #Y1.5%#E during damage calculation for #Y5#E seconds. During this time, any #YMoonphase#E or #YMoonlure#E gained is consumed by #YMoonlure#E and extends its duration by #Y2#E seconds, up to #Y15#E seconds total.
Increases <Max Physical Attack|780|#C|15> based on Solo Mode Level.

As the tide swells to its height, heaven and earth gather force. During #YMoonlure#E, dealing direct damage inflicts #YUndertow#E on the target for #Y5#E seconds. For all damage dealt by the source of this effect, <Direct Affinity Rate|780|#C|150> is increased by #Y0.3%#E during damage calculation. Stacks up to #Y5#E times.

Frost and snow fall together as the tides crash in answer. At max stacks, #YUndertow#E deals #YTidesurge#E damage to the target once per second and applies #YTidemark#E to non-player units for #Y30#E seconds. If #YUndertow#E expires during this time and the target is hit by Affinity damage from the mark's source again, #Y5#E stacks of #YUndertow#E are reactivated and the source gains #YMoonlure#E.

Gales roar, tides surge, and waves rise to blot out the sun. The first #YTidesurge#E against the target will upgrade into #YTowering Tide#E, dealing AOE damage to up to five surrounding enemies, with subsequent triggers occurring every #Y10#E instances of #YTidesurge#E. Damage dealt by #YTidesurge#E and #YTowering Tide#E to non-player units can be further increased based on <Effective Affinity Rate|780|#C|23>, up to a maximum of #Y30%#E at #Y30%#E accumulated <Effective Affinity Rate|780|#C|23>.
